items.title: Keep one agent list status indicator
items.detail: The Agents toolbar shows a single spinner or warning while the list refreshes or when it fails, including while you scroll or filter the list.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Compatible with Tightbeam: none verified. This build was not verified against Tightbeam 0.1.16 (build 4304), Tightbeam 0.1.15 (build 4082), or Chat v0.1.104. No version-specific test evidence is tied to this build.

items.title: Breaking changes
items.detail: None.

items.title: See agent list status beside the heading
items.detail: A spinner beside Agents shows when the list is refreshing, with cached agents still visible. If the list fails to load, tap the warning icon to see and copy the error.

items.detail: Compatible with Tightbeam: none verified. This build was not verified against Tightbeam 0.1.16 (build 4304), Tightbeam 0.1.15 (build 4082), or Chat v0.1.104. No version-specific test evidence is tied to this build.

items.title: Breaking changes
items.detail: None.

items.title: Show waiting agents in Replies
items.detail: After you send a prompt, the agent appears in Replies with a spinner until it responds, including while its chat is open. A failed send clears the spinner; when a reply arrives, Tuner follows the existing read and unread behavior.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Tightbeam compatibility was not verified for this build. Chat v0.1.104. Chat v0.1.101 does not work in Tuner.

items.title: Breaking changes
items.detail: None.

items.title: Paste photos from the clipboard
items.detail: Choose Paste in the + menu to add a copied photo to the message field. It sends with its words through Chat's existing attachment flow. Text paste and Photo Library selection remain available.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Tightbeam compatibility was not verified for this build. Chat v0.1.104. Chat v0.1.101 does not work in Tuner.

items.detail: None.

items.title: Agent list loads when the server's shell prints warnings
items.detail: Tuner now loads the agent list whenever the server's roster command succeeds, even if the SSH login prints warnings along the way. If the command fails or doesn't return an agent list, Tuner says so and shows what the server printed.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Tightbeam compatibility was not verified for this build. Chat v0.1.104. Chat v0.1.101 does not work in Tuner.

items.title: Breaking changes
items.detail: None.

items.title: Edit and resend a failed prompt
items.detail: When an agent can't answer a prompt, tap Edit and resend under it in Chat. The prompt's words come back to the message field, with its photos when Chat still has them; Tuner says so when it can't restore the photos. Edit and tap Send to send it as a new message. Nothing is sent until you tap Send. Needs a Chat version that offers Edit and resend to Tuner; with earlier Chat versions, the failed prompt shows as before.

items.detail: None.

items.title: Connect stays available while Chat reconnects
items.detail: If Chat is still reconnecting after a few seconds, tapping the connection dot offers Connect, and Tuner retries on its own on the same schedule it uses when Chat shows disconnected. The dot stays yellow until Chat reports a change.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Tightbeam compatibility was not verified for this build. Chat v0.1.104. Chat v0.1.101 does not work in Tuner.

items.title: Catch up older Replies after reconnecting
items.detail: When the Gateway provides message-sequence summaries, Tuner checks older conversations that changed while disconnected without reloading every conversation. It continues checking pending prompts, changed read positions and recent conversations; older Replies may wait for a live update.

items.title: Compatibility

items.title: Keep Replies current after reconnecting
items.detail: Tuner catches up pending prompts and changed read positions, plus a small set of recent conversations. On first load, it checks recent conversations and restores pending prompts. A reply received during disconnection for an older agent may appear in Replies after its next live update; opening that chat still shows it.

Historical roster output contained the required string fields, and a pre-recovery Tuner Debug build opened a conversation, sent one prompt, and displayed the reply with Chat v0.1.100. That conversation check predates the recovery change. The recovery change has not been exercised with Chat v0.1.101, and Tuner's in-app SSH roster fetch was not exercised.

items.title: Recover embedded Chat automatically
items.detail: Tuner now checks embedded Chat after a navigation or connection failure and tries to restore it if it stays unavailable. When you return to Tuner, it waits before checking so a slow page has time to load.

items.title: Breaking changes
items.detail: None.

items.title: See the photo button in every conversation
items.detail: The + button beside the status dot now always shows. It is greyed out when the conversation's Chat version does not yet accept photos from Tuner, and works as before when it does.

items.title: Send photos from the message field
items.detail: Tap + beside the status dot to paste a photo, choose photos from your library, or take one with the camera. Photos wait above the message field, where you can remove them, and send with or without words. A photo that does not send comes back with its words so you can retry. The + button appears when the conversation's Chat version accepts photos from Tuner; until then the message field is unchanged.

items.title: Give the message field more room
items.detail: The one-line message field is taller and keeps its ends fully rounded. Multiline editing and Send remain available.

items.title: Keep waiting agents on their rows
items.detail: After you send a prompt, the agent stays in its existing Recent and Agents rows with a spinner while it waits. Waiting agents stay in Recent even if the list grows beyond ten. After relaunch, agents still waiting regain their spinner, and existing Replies entries remain available. A reply stops the spinner and restores the existing Replies behavior; failed sends show no spinner.

items.title: See each agent's model and effort
items.detail: The Agents list now shows each agent's archetype followed by its actual model and effort.

items.title: Let the conversation run under the message field
items.detail: The conversation fills the chat screen, folded or unfolded, in portrait and landscape. The toolbar and message field float over it, with no empty or white bars, and Latest messages stays clear of the message field.

items.title: Leave room above the keyboard
items.detail: With the keyboard up, the message field sits a small gap above it. The message field now follows the system layout instead of lining up with Filter agents.

items.title: Keep the message field aligned with Filter
items.detail: The message field follows Filter as the keyboard opens and closes, with conversation space reserved around it.

items.title: Scroll beneath floating controls
items.detail: Portrait conversations can scroll beneath the floating toolbar. Landscape conversations use the top safe area without an extra gap.

items.title: Keep Replies up to date
items.detail: Sent prompts now reliably appear in Replies with a spinner until an assistant responds. In side-by-side layouts, the row stays unread with its back arrow until you leave or mark the conversation read.

items.title: Give Tuner a clear look in both themes
items.detail: Tuner's light and dark palettes, type, button feedback, and panels now follow its design system on desktop and iOS.

items.title: Match Chat colors across appearances
items.detail: Chat's background, composer accents, and connection indicator now match Chat in both light and dark appearances.

items.title: See when an agent is replying
items.detail: After an accepted prompt, the agent moves from Agents to Replies with a spinner until a new assistant message arrives. If sending fails, the agent stays in Agents.

items.title: Keep release notes with every update
items.detail: Each numbered update needs its own author-written notes before release. The same notes appear in What's Changed and TestFlight.

items.title: Keep Chat clear during its first layout
items.detail: Tuner reserves space for its message field before Chat's first layout measurement, keeping the conversation controls clear.

items.title: See your saved agents at launch
items.detail: Tuner shows the saved agent list as soon as it opens, then reconciles it with the current roster.

items.title: Send sits beside the message field
items.detail: Send is a separate control beside the field and stays aligned with the last line as the field grows.

items.title: See when an agent is replying
items.detail: After you send a prompt, its row moves to Replies with a spinner until a new assistant message arrives. If sending fails, the row stays where it was.

items.title: Send matches the message field
items.detail: The one-line Send control matches the 44-point field height, while multiline drafts keep it aligned with the last line.

items.title: Release notes match the build
items.detail: Each numbered archive requires notes for that exact build. Tuner's What's Changed and TestFlight use the same authored notes.

items.title: Keep the compact message field full size
items.detail: The empty or one-line message field keeps its full height and rounded ends in compact layouts.

items.title: Keep Chat's layout in step with the keyboard
items.detail: When Tuner returns to the foreground, Chat refreshes its keyboard layout to match the keyboard's current position.

items.title: Keep the message field aligned with the keyboard
items.detail: In compact layouts, the message field follows the keyboard's current visibility while it stays focused.

items.title: The agent list stays where you left it
items.detail: When you return to Tuner, the list stays open, closed, or floating where it was. Rotating while Tuner is active keeps working as before.

items.title: The agent list stays up to date
items.detail: New agents appear, changed details update, and retired agents disappear while Tuner is open, without pulling to refresh.

items.title: The agent list stays up to date
items.detail: New agents appear, changed details update, and retired agents disappear while Tuner is open, without pulling to refresh.

items.title: Keep the message field aligned with the keyboard
items.detail: In compact layouts, the message field follows the keyboard's current visibility while it stays focused.

items.title: The agent list stays where you left it
items.detail: When you return to Tuner, the list stays open, closed, or floating where it was. Rotating while Tuner is active keeps working as before.

items.title: Keep Chat's layout in step with the keyboard
items.detail: When Tuner returns to the foreground, Chat refreshes its keyboard layout to match the keyboard's current position.

items.title: Keep the compact message field full size
items.detail: The empty or one-line message field keeps its full height and rounded ends in compact layouts.

items.title: Keep the message field full size when the keyboard closes
items.detail: When the keyboard closes, the empty message field keeps room for its text and send button while its bottom stays aligned with Filter agents.

items.title: Match the message field to Filter agents
items.detail: On iPhone, the empty message field matches Filter agents in height and stays the same distance from the bottom as the keyboard opens or closes. Side by side, their edges line up while Chat content stays clear of the field.

items.title: Keep filtered iPad results above the keyboard
items.detail: At standard text size on iPad, the last filtered result stays visible above the keyboard, clear of Filter agents, and tappable.

items.title: The agent list stays where you left it
items.detail: When you return to Tuner, the list stays open, closed, or floating where it was. Rotating while Tuner is active keeps working as before.

items.title: Restore the standard agent-list control
items.detail: The standard sidebar button is back without a Replied count because this system-owned control has no supported badge mechanism.

items.title: Filtered results sit closer to Filter agents
items.detail: The last matching agent stays visible just above Filter agents, with the keyboard open or closed.

items.title: See Replied from the list controls
items.detail: When the agent list is hidden, its return control shows how many agents are listed in Replied after filtering.

items.title: Filter results stay clear
items.detail: Scroll the last matching agent above Filter agents and tap it, with the keyboard open or closed.

items.title: Chat stays clear of the top bar
items.detail: The conversation now starts below Tuner's top toolbar, so its controls stay clear.

items.title: Remove a chat from Recent
items.detail: Swipe a Recent row to reveal X and remove it from this device. Open its chat again to add it back.

items.title: Replied opens the conversation
items.detail: Tapping a reply opens its chat while clearing it from Replied on this device.

items.title: Replied follows the chat on screen
items.detail: A reply joins Replied only when Tuner receives it while its chat is off screen on this device. Replies that arrive while the chat is open stay out after you switch away, reconnect, or restart.

items.title: Collapse agent sections
items.detail: Replied, Recent and Agents now collapse and expand independently, and Tuner remembers each choice. Their count pills follow text and archetype filters; collapsing a section or agent branch does not change the count. Grey parent rows shown only for context are left out of the Agents count.

items.title: Getting ready for shared read positions
items.detail: Once available, Tuner can pick up which replies you have read on your other devices.

items.title: Replied starts with new replies
items.detail: When nothing has been marked as read yet, Replied starts empty and fills with replies that arrive while Tuner is open.

items.title: Opening a chat clears it from Replied
items.detail: An agent leaves Replied when you open its chat and returns when it replies again.

items.title: Replied
items.detail: Agents that replied to you appear at the top of the agent list, newest first, until you read their reply.

items.title: Message field lines up with Filter agents
items.detail: Wherever the agent list sits beside the chat, the message field now sits level with Filter agents, including on iOS 27 and iPhone Duo.

items.title: Swipe in from the left for agents
items.detail: A swipe from the left edge opens the agent list, even after Chat opens another page.

items.title: Send while Chat reconnects
items.detail: A reconnecting feed no longer disables Send. The button stays grey when Chat is unavailable, a message is still on its way to Chat, or the field is empty.

items.title: The dot follows Chat's connection
items.detail: Green means connected, yellow means reconnecting, and red means disconnected. Connect reconnects in place and keeps your place in the conversation.

items.title: The conversation moves with the keyboard
items.detail: When the keyboard opens or closes, the newest message slides along with it and the message field, instead of jumping first and leaving an empty gap.

items.title: Message field lines up with Filter
items.detail: On a large iPhone in landscape, with the agent list beside the chat, the message field sits level with the Filter agents field.

items.title: The dot shows the connection
items.detail: The Reconnecting banner is gone. The dot in the message field shows the connection: green when connected, yellow while reconnecting, red when disconnected. When it is red, tap it and choose Connect.

items.title: Send is grey when it can't send
items.detail: While Chat is reconnecting, or the field is empty, the send button turns grey and can't be tapped. If Chat turns a message away because it's reconnecting, the button stays grey until Chat is back.

items.title: Send the next message sooner
items.detail: Once Chat accepts a message, you can send another right away instead of waiting for it to arrive. A message that does not send comes back to the field so you can retry it.

items.title: Unsent messages are kept
items.detail: A message you started typing stays in the field for that agent, even after you quit Tuner or iOS closes it in the background.

items.title: Chat comes back after the background
items.detail: When iOS clears the chat page while Tuner is in the background, Tuner reloads it as soon as you return, instead of showing a blank page.

items.title: The newest message stays in view
items.detail: At the bottom of a conversation, the newest message moves up above the keyboard and the message field instead of hiding behind them. Conversations also open at the newest message.

items.title: Chat's own message field keeps the keyboard
items.detail: When Chat shows its own message field instead of Tuner's, tapping it always brings up the keyboard.

items.title: Send button fits the field again
items.detail: The send button sits evenly inside the field's rounded end, as it did before the connection dot.

items.title: Keyboard stays while you read
items.detail: Tapping the conversation or Latest messages no longer puts the keyboard away while you type.

items.title: Connection dot
items.detail: The message field shows Chat's connection dot at its left again. Tap it for connection details.

items.title: Agent list closes after choosing
items.detail: When the agent list floats over the chat, such as in portrait, choosing an agent closes it. Opening the list puts the keyboard away.

items.title: Swipe down to hide the keyboard
items.detail: Swipe down on the conversation to put the keyboard away.

items.title: Choose how many recents
items.detail: Settings sets how many recently opened agents appear in the list, from none up to 50.

items.title: Archetype under each agent
items.detail: Every agent in the list shows its archetype below its name.

items.title: Release notes
items.detail: After an update, Tuner shows what changed, once. Every release's notes stay in Settings under Release Notes.

items.title: Chat stays in its column
items.detail: The chat page keeps clear of the sidebar, so Latest messages and other centered controls sit in the middle of the chat.

items.title: Pinch to change text size
items.detail: Pinch the conversation to make its text larger or smaller. Tuner remembers the size.

items.title: Message field fits the chat
items.detail: The message field centers in the chat column and stops at a comfortable line length on wide screens.

items.title: Return key
items.detail: The keyboard's Return key now reads Return, since it starts a new line.

items.title: Filter while searching
items.detail: The archetype filter stays available while you search the agent list.

items.title: Nordic colors
items.detail: Tuner uses the same linen, off-black and moss palette as Tightbeam Chat, in light and dark.

items.title: Narrow screens
items.detail: Chat no longer runs under side bars on very narrow screens, such as a folded phone.

items.title: Liquid Glass message field
items.detail: A native message field floats over the conversation.
